context: Interactive linked scatterplot matrix with brush-composition (union/intersection) for exploring health metrics across 6 panel pairs
first_impression: Clean, professional small-multiples layout with a restrained Tol palette and clear typographic hierarchy that feels deliberately designed rather than default.
what_works: The Tol color palette (blue/pink/green) is a thoughtful, colorblind-friendly choice that avoids the schemeCategory10 trap; the progressive annotation system (count badge → centroid crosshair → outlier diamonds) adds analytical depth without visual clutter at rest.
what_doesnt: Panel titles use the same weight and size as everything else — the 'vs' construction makes them verbose and they compete visually with axis labels rather than sitting clearly above them; the 8-gap grid leaves panels slightly cramped relative to the 1200px container, reducing breathing room between the six plots.
